figurative_meaning_en: The innate emotional pull towards one's roots or homeland
example_sentences_in_bangla: দীর্ঘদিন বিদেশে থাকার পরও নাড়ির টানে সে দেশে ফিরে এল।
পুরনো বাড়ির নাড়ির টান তাকে সবসময় টানে।
example_sentences_in_english: After living abroad for many years, he returned home due to the pull of his roots.
The pull of the old house always tugs at her heart.
note: Often used in contexts of expatriates returning to Bengal or India
